summary: The note describes the men's ice hockey tournament at the 2018 Winter Olympics, held in Gangneung, South Korea from 14 to 25 February 2018. Twelve countries took part: eight qualified automatically through IIHF rankings, South Korea qualified as hosts, and three entered via a qualification tournament. The note is a brief introductory passage and gives no further details on results or matches.
one_line: Overview of the men's ice hockey tournament at the 2018 Winter Olympics in Gangneung, South Korea, including how the twelve teams qualified.
key_facts: The men's ice hockey tournament at the 2018 Winter Olympics was held in Gangneung, South Korea.
The tournament was held between 14 and 25 February 2018.
Twelve countries qualified for the men's tournament.
Eight countries qualified automatically by virtue of their ranking by the International Ice Hockey Federation.
South Korea automatically qualified as hosts.
Three countries took part in a qualification tournament to enter the men's tournament.
The eight countries qualifying by IIHF ranking, plus South Korea as hosts, plus three qualifiers, make up the twelve teams.
